The results for small $N$ showed a clear pattern: $k = N - \lfloor \sqrt{N-1} \rfloor$. For $N=7396$, this gives $k = 7396 - \lfloor \sqrt{7395} \rfloor = 7396 - 85 = 7311$. The condition that two merchants must have non-crossing matchings (because $s_i$ and $b_i$ are strictly increasing) and $P_j$ is the set of reachable pairs in such matchings leads to this relationship. I verified the pattern for $N$ from 3 up to 12.
